ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; approximately 85% low-intensity (black) surface area versus 15% high-intensity (white) localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast white annular rings (rosettes) distributed non-uniformly across a black background; higher density of rings observed in the medial regions and along the trailing edge of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch measured at approximately 135 degrees at the central apex intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary; a prominent deeper indentation is visible on the far left lateral tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the upper trailing edge transitioning to convex curves towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely populated clusters of white circular and ring-shaped pixel formations (barnacle scars) covering approximately 60% of the visible surface area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, thin white linear streaks (rake marks) detected on the right lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white circular scarring (rosettes) across both lobes; minor fraying/notching on the far left lateral edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and dense distribution of ring-like scars creates a 'polka-dot' visual texture across the entire ventral fluke.
